title: BD2 Secret Vision Assistant
subtitle: Automatic claiming · Retry failed rounds · Stop when selected stages are done
empty: Open SECRET VISION in the game and connect. The board appears here when a round starts.
stages-help: Selected stages run from 1 to 5. Choose stages you have unlocked.
retry: Retry if target is not reached
attempts-help: 0 means unlimited; use 1–1000 for a limit.
operation-help: Start ends the current round and begins a new one. Stop releases input and pauses. Starting again opens a new round. No automatic revival.
diagnostic-help: Select and copy the path or diagnostic text. Remove personal paths before sharing; do not upload game DLLs.
attribution: Free & open source · GitHub: MadestSamurai · Bilibili: MadSamurai
notice: Official author releases are free and unaffiliated with the game publisher. Assistance tools may cause account penalties, bans, failures or data loss. Follow game rules and use at your own risk. Third-party fees do not imply endorsement. The MIT License remains unchanged.
single-instance: The assistant is already open. Check your taskbar.
invalid-attempts: Attempts must be a whole number from 0 to 1000. Your input is preserved.
settings-unreadable: Settings could not be read. The original file is unchanged.
game-not-running: Start the game and log in first.
multiple-games: Multiple game processes found. Keep only one running.
permission: Cannot access the game. Run the assistant with the same privileges as the game.
open-secret-vision: Open the SECRET VISION home screen in the game.
component-heartbeat-missing: No fresh component state. Check diagnostics and the game connection.
restart-game-component: An older component is loaded. Restart the game normally before connecting.
awaiting-server-confirmation: This round has not been confirmed by the server. Stopped with the current state preserved.
attempt-timeout: This attempt timed out and stopped.
failure: Operation could not complete. Expand diagnostics for details.
file-access: A local file could not be accessed. See diagnostics for the path and cause.
等待小游戏结算回读: Waiting for the minigame result confirmation
